subject: business-studies
title: Pricing Strategies Adventure
welcome_lead: You'll calculate cost-plus prices and pick between penetration, skimming and psychological pricing.
meta_desc: GCSE Business Studies — cost-plus, penetration, skimming, competitive and psychological pricing.
final_note: You can name pricing strategies, calculate cost-plus prices and match strategies to context.

concepts.def: Low launch price to gain market share fast
High launch price for new/innovative products
% added to cost to get the selling price

walkthroughs.body_html:
Price = cost + mark-up.

If cost is £8 and mark-up is 25%, mark-up = £2 and price = £10. Easy but ignores what customers will pay.

Penetration: low intro price to grab share (e.g. new streaming service).

Skimming: high intro price for fans willing to pay (new iPhone), then lower it later.

Psychological pricing uses £9.99, £19.99 to look cheaper.

Competitive pricing matches rivals when products are similar — common in supermarkets.
